crier.jaymoskingdoms.hear_ye.0: Hear ye, hear ye! The court of %s has sat!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.hear_ye.1: Oyez, oyez! News from the court of %s!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.hear_ye.2: Hear ye! Gather round, the court of %s has spoken!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.0: Taken for %2$s, %1$s is pardoned by the crown!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.1: Judged for %2$s, %1$s walks free. Mercy, this once!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.2: For %2$s, %1$s is forgiven. Let it not happen again!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.0: For %2$s, %1$s is flogged! Mind the law, all of you!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.1: For %2$s, %1$s has taken the lash before the seat!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.2: Judged for %2$s, %1$s is flogged, and it is done!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.0: For %2$s, %1$s is banished! None shall give them roof or bread!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.1: For %2$s, %1$s is cast out of the realm, never to return!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.2: Judged for %2$s, %1$s is exiled! Bar the gates to them!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.0: For %2$s, %1$s is put to death! So ends every enemy of the peace!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.1: For %2$s, %1$s has gone to the block!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.2: Judged for %2$s, %1$s has paid with their head!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.0: For %2$s, %1$s is thrown in the cells!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.1: For %2$s, %1$s goes below to the cells!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.2: Judged for %2$s, %1$s sits in the cells under the seat!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.taken.0: From the lord's wood the ranger brings in %s, an outlaw poacher, who will not be seen again!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.taken.1: For poaching, the ranger has brought in %s, an outlaw! The court has dealt with them!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.taken.2: For poaching in the lord's wood, %s the outlaw is taken away!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.fined.0: For poaching, %s is brought in! Their own realm pays the fine!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.fined.1: The ranger has brought in %s for poaching! Fined, and let go!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.fined.2: For poaching in the lord's wood, %s is fined, their own realm to pay!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.folk_let_of: There's no court near enough to take you to, %s. Go on, and let that be the last beast.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.folk_to_cou: On to the court of %2$s with you, %1$s.
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.kin.0: Liar! That's my own blood you're crying about!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.kin.1: You'll shout my family's shame in the street, will you?
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.kin.2: Shut your mouth! You don't know the half of it!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.soft.0: Pardoned? A thief walks free, and you ring a bell for it?
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.soft.1: Mercy, he calls it. Soft, I call it.
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.soft.2: Let them all go, then! Why have a court at all?
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.attack.1: Say it again. Go on, say it to my face!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.attack.2: That's the last thing you'll cry in this town!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.help.0: Help! Guards! I only cry the court's words!
crier.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.help.1: Watch! The watch! I'm set upon!
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.crier.0: A man in a hood was asking which way %s walks home. Someone didn't like the news.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.crier.1: I heard coin changed hands over %s. Over the crying, they say.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.crier.2: Somebody's family wants %s quiet. For good.
assassin.jaymoskingdoms.crier.stabbed.2: Who sent you? I only cry the news!
item.jaymoskingdoms.sealed_contract.by.k: Signed with a family's mark: kin of one the crier named
